deliverables: Full-stack open-source payments infrastructure for Cardano
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Stablecoin-backed banking rails and compliance architecture
Milestone-based disbursement controls through Intersect treasury smart contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for “Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex.”

claims.claim: The proposal says Cardano lacks seamless infrastructure for everyday spending, merchant acceptance, and fiat-connected financial activity at scale.

The proposal claims it will deliver full-stack, open-source payments infrastructure enabling onchain settlement, banking rails, stablecoin systems, wallet interfaces, and Visa card issuance linked to onchain balances.
Wirex is described as having 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and Visa Principal Member experience.
The proposal claims the work will increase Cardano utility through new transaction volume, user growth, institutional participation, and real-world economic activity onchain.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting, audit, and results references.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.
The budget allocates 3,846,153 ada to WP1 Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure and 115,385 ada to the Intersect Budget Administration fee, totaling 3,961,538 ada.
The proposal states audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
The proposal states Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.
The proposal identifies specific TRSC and PSSC addresses, administrative authorization thresholds, an Oversight Committee, and a public dashboard for auditing the withdrawn ada.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ada for a Wirex real-world payments initiative, combining Cardano payment infrastructure, card and banking-rail integration, open-source components, and Intersect-managed treasury smart contract oversight.
